test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: W is the son of D. C is the daughter of D's son. P's sister N is married to W. D is the husband of K. How is K related to C?
solution:
The common symbol used are as shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51b7624bf0afefe40ada2e7bbf828abd4f8c4daa696ee888ece0e4f1408b5458.png] 

1) W is the son of D. C is the daughter of D's son.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/455c8b95a2bef1d44eb6da0abc64451de73e49b831a05491e0b7689449ab1c9a.png] 

2) P's sister N is married to W. D is the husband of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcf32c5ed46a77f402f934d45b341b81457e3d45562f03c5a831fdfac7d18e63.png] 

Clearly, we can see that **K **is the paternal grandmother of **C.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Paternal grandmother".**
